breakdown.description: A 25% atomic-size mismatch violates the usual Hume–Rothery size criterion for complete substitutional solubility.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a 25% atomic-size mismatch violates the Hume–Rothery size criterion, which states the difference should be no more than ~15%. The ground truth fixed this by changing the value to 8%. The agent fixed it by explaining why the 25% value makes the original prompt's conclusion incorrect. Both methods successfully resolve the scientific contradiction, and the agent did not repeat the user's flawed assumption.
